reference.content: PRINCE2 with Six Sigma Black Belt; Project and Energy Lead; PGDPM; B.Tech Electrical; 18+ years across projects, maintenance, OpEx, plant upkeep, and energy saving. Experience spans steel, cement, and food manufacturing. Directed and supported multi-crore capex initiatives. Core principles: Integrity, Commitment, Passion, Teamwork, Speed.

content: Led design for 39kton food plant in Gamharia, Value: ₹ 265 Cr
Directed 4kton extrusion line at Adityapur, Value: ₹ 9 Cr
Managed Hammer Mill, Packer, roofing, fire alarm and more, Value: ₹ 650 lakh
Oversaw LPG system (75T, 468kg/hr.) for boiler, civil works (₹ 4.8 Cr), rooftop solar design (₹ 8.2 Cr), and atta line (₹ 4.9 Cr)
Ran pavement jobs, fuel automation and more (₹ 4.9 Cr), PFD line design, and madua (ragi) flour line
Delivered 1,36,735 litres soya oil tank and transfer system, plus plant upgrades (₹ 4.9 Cr)
Steered cross-team delivery end-to-end, meeting quality, budget, and timeline in a matrix setup.
Raised plant availability from 84% to 92%
Cut downtime by 8%.
Boosted capacity 30% in 2 years with zero CAPEX via OpEx.
Lowered energy spend 74% and saved ₹ 36 crore in 2 years through efficiency, OpEx, kaizen, and select investments

Headed E&I for install and start-up of 2.7 MTPA integrated cement plant from mine, crusher, raw mill, kiln, cement mill, packing, utilities (Substation 132Kv, compressor, chilled water/management, coal handling), E&I scope: ₹ 210 Cr.
Completed plant ramp-up successfully.
Created WIs, JHAs, and maintenance plans for I&C.
Launched safety programs, JSA, LOTO, and electrical standards.
Built WIs, JHAs, and I&C maintenance plans.
Streamlined spares inventory.
Cut breakdowns by 19%
Conducted a successful BEE energy audit.
Directed E&I install and start-up of 9 cement rail wagon loaders, truck loaders, and packers.
Led E&I installation in 31MW CPP, switchgear (160KV/6.6KV, 24.2 MVA & 7.5Kv/415V, 13MVA)
Implemented WCM, IEC, EHS, NFPA 70Es and administered SAP- PM/PS.
Reduced SEC from 2.0kwh/ton to 0.9kwh/ton over 3 years.
Shrank section downtime from 1722 to 166 hours in 3 years.
Launched focused improvement
Deployed a maintenance system for EOT cranes, motors, panels, and cold-drawn ACSR equipment
Helped cut breakdowns by 2% in 11 months by improving care of motors, panels, VFDs, and PLCs
Supported E&I install and start-up of the CRM pickling line and 33kV grid feeders
Started continual improvement projects in the domain.
